status: static audit; no runtime edit or CI
findings: The original Planner source host and readScopedSourcePrepared capability are preserved by business-services→Planner product→source host. No missing batch method was found at this boundary.

Each resolver performs two original read observations. Each prepared read authenticates its selector, authorizes twice, projects the original source, observes physical/scoped identity and retains original materialization semantics. The outer resolver compares both observations and revalidates authority.

source-lifecycle readScopedSourcePrepared asks currentLocalReadonlyAuthorityData for input.persistence. Installed local/entry supplies currentChoiceFence.persistence, while LocalStore's private WeakMap registers only the original store object. This loses the generic readonly ACL optimization for the installed wrapper.

Without plannerAcl, observe computes a full snapshot digest before and after callbacks and uses the generic snapshot path. The existing injected observeAuthority can observe readonly or writer preimage scopes and must not be treated as an equivalent readonly proof.

A legitimate bridge must retain actual LocalStore readonly provenance, current owner/provider/method pins after every await and the original callbacks. Same immutable bytes alone do not establish the same physical or lexical scope.

Measured source phase durations include all these actions; no inner timing in this profile assigns their complete duration to hashing or copying. No projection, authorization or result cache is proposed by this audit.
